description: Unit tests for the ChatSheetContent component in the Android app, testing functions related to pending assistant auto-send logic.

classes.name: ChatSheetContentTest
classes.description: Test class for ChatSheetContent functions, verifying the behavior of resolving and dispatching assistant auto-send prompts.

methods.name: resolvesPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Tests that resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend returns null in certain conditions and the expected prompt string when conditions are met.

methods.name: keepsPendingAssistantAutoSendWhenDispatchRejected
methods.description: Verifies that dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend does not consume the prompt when dispatch is rejected (callback returns false).

methods.name: clearsPendingAssistantAutoSendOnlyAfterAcceptedDispatch
methods.description: Verifies that dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend clears the prompt only if the dispatch callback returns true.
